pairs: et nolite iterum jugo servitutis contineri.
and do not be willing to be again held by the yoke of servitude.
Ecce ego Paulus dico vobis: quoniam si circumcidamini, Christus vobis nihil proderit.
Behold, I, Paul, say to you, that if you have been circumcised, Christ will be of no benefit to you.
Testificor autem rursus omni homini circumcidenti se,
For I again testify, about every man circumcising himself,
quoniam debitor est universæ legis faciendæ.
that he is obligated to act according to the entire law.
You are being emptied of Christ,
you who are being justified by the law.
we await the hope of justice.
Nam in Christo Jesu neque circumcisio aliquid valet,
but only faith which works through charity.
quis vos impedivit veritati non obedire?
So what has impeded you, that you would not obey the truth?
persuasio hæc non est ex eo, qui vocat vos.
This kind of influence is not from him who is calling you.
A little leaven corrupts the whole mass.
Ego confido in vobis in Domino,
I have confidence in you, in the Lord,
that you will accept nothing of the kind.
qui autem conturbat vos, portabit judicium,
However, he who disturbs you shall bear the judgment,
why am I still suffering persecution?
For then the scandal of the Cross would be made empty.
Utinam et abscindantur qui vos conturbant.
And I wish that those who disturb you would be torn away.
Vos enim in libertatem vocati estis,
For you, brothers, have been called to liberty.
fratres: tantum ne libertatem in occasionem detis carnis,
Only you must not make liberty into an occasion for the flesh, but instead,
sed per caritatem Spiritus servite invicem.
serve one another through the charity of the Spirit.
Omnis enim lex in uno sermone impletur:
For the entire law is fulfilled by one word:
“You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
be careful that you are not consumed by one another!
and you will not fulfill the desires of the flesh.
For the flesh desires against the spirit,
and the spirit against the flesh.
And since these are against one another,
ut non quæcumque vultis, illa faciatis.
you may not do whatever you want.
But if you are led by the Spirit,
you are not under the law.
Now the works of the flesh are manifest;
I continue to preach to you,
as I have preached to you:
that those who act in this way shall not obtain the kingdom of God.
But the fruit of the Spirit is charity,
There is no law against such things.
For those who are Christ’s have crucified their flesh,
carnem suam crucifixerunt cum vitiis et concupiscentiis.
along with its vices and desires.
If we live by the Spirit,
we should also walk by the Spirit.
Let us not become desirous of empty glory,
